newsitem.title: USA: IPO FILING-International Total Services Inc.
newsitem.headline: IPO FILING-International Total Services Inc.

text.p: Company Name International Total Services Inc
Shrs offered by shareholders* 227,273 Shrs outstanding after ipo 6,251,636

Lead Underwriter McDonald & Co Securities Inc Underwriters over-allotment 423,750 shrs Sellng shareholder is Robert Weitzel, chief executive officer. Business: Based in Independence, Ohio., the company is a domestic provider of aviation services for more than 60 U.S. and international carriers at more than 130 U.S. airports. Use of Proceeds: Net will be used to repay outstanding debt and for general corporate purposes, including working capital to support the company's growth and for possible acquisitions.
